**Coaching note:**
After your opponent moves a piece, always scan for undefended pieces—especially valuable ones like queens. Here, White's queen on a3 wasn't protected. Your queen could simply capture it for free. When the opponent has an undefended piece in a position where you have pieces attacking it, take it without hesitation unless your opponent has an immediate checkmate threat (they don't here).
